conversation_turns.text: Hi, I'm Noah. I'm here because of some back pain I've been having for about a week. It started after I twisted my left side, maybe picked something up, and the pain came back after a few hours. It's been there since then, and it gets worse when I make sudden movements to the left.

conversation_turns.text: I'm male, and I'm not sure about my exact age. The pain is more in the middle of my lower back, and sometimes it goes to the left side. It's not too bad, but it gets worse when I twist suddenly to the left. I don't have any numbness or tingling in my legs, just the pain.
